Adding deterministic chirality reveals a sharp qualitative change in the sign of the leading fourth-order deviation, whereas second-order diffusivity stays smooth. The precise dimensionless critical ratio and robustness to independent thermal Brownian translation are motivated observable benchmarks, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
